facts.text: Founded in 1916 by the Sisters of St. Joseph, St. Joseph's University, New York has been dedicated to providing a values-oriented, affordable education rooted in the liberal arts tradition for more than 100 years.

sources.title: Fast Facts | About Us | St. Joseph's University, New York
sources.quote: Founded in 1916 by the Sisters of St. Joseph, St. Joseph's University, New York has been dedicated to providing a values-oriented, affordable education rooted in the liberal arts tradition for more than 100 years.

facts.text: The Dillon Child Study Center at the Brooklyn campus, which serves as a teaching facility for child study majors and a preschool for the community, was one of the first of its kind on the East Coast.
